characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your Charge phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:


- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- Select one enemy unit within 9” of this model. That unit makes a battle-shock roll with -2 to that battle-shock roll.

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
After this unit has attacked, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:

- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- Choose one enemy unit hit by this units attacks this phase. That unit must make a Ld test at -1. If it fails the Ld test that unit has -1" movement..
